per_object_cap.stated: Four sizes: 'Tiny 1 vCPU · 2 GB RAM · 20 GB disk $0.0068 $5', 'Small 2 vCPU · 4 GB · 80 GB $0.0137 $10', 'Medium 4 vCPU · 8 GB · 160 GB $0.0274 $20', 'Large 6 vCPU · 16 GB · 320 GB $0.0548 $40'.
per_object_cap.notes: The per-month column is the 24/7 price at that size.

interface_detail: web console and API; the platform also bills model and API calls through the same balance
tooling: web dashboard; per-box itemised model and API spend
chaining: a cheap 4 vCPU box whose balance also pays for model calls, so an agent and its inference share one wallet
limits_note: The balance also pays for model and API calls made through platform keys, so compute and inference compete for the same USD 25.
reliability_note: 'A positive balance is what boots a machine', so a zero balance stops the box rather than billing overage.

free_tier.stated: 'Every new account can get $25 in credit with a one-time $5 top-up. A positive balance is what boots a machine. Top up by card; the card is saved for auto top-up.'
free_tier.notes: A deposit match, not a grant: USD 5 must be paid by card first. 'Credits are prepaid and non-refundable.'

retention.stated: 'Paused boxes cost $0.' No deletion timer for a paused box is stated.

egress.terms: No egress charge or allowance is stated on the pricing page.

limits.value: USD 25 credit requires a one-time USD 5 top-up
Medium 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 160 GB at USD 0.0274 an hour, USD 20 a month

identity_cost.detail: A card is required for the USD 5 top-up before any credit lands, and 'the card is saved for auto top-up'. No hold amount is stated; the charge is a real USD 5, not an authorisation.

evidence.proved: USD 25 in credit with a one-time USD 5 top-up; paused boxes cost USD 0; card saved for auto top-up

quoted: 'Every new account can get $25 in credit with a one-time $5 top-up. A positive balance is what boots a machine. Top up by card; the card is saved for auto top-up.'; 'Medium 4 vCPU · 8 GB RAM · 160 GB disk $0.0274 $20'; 'Paused boxes cost $0.'; 'Credits are prepaid and non-refundable.'

notes: USD 25 at Medium's USD 0.0274 is 912 hours, so the match buys 1.25 months of a 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 160 GB machine for USD 5 out of pocket, which is the lowest cash cost for a 4 vCPU month anywhere. It is card-gated at signup and the balance is shared with inference, so it is not a free tier.

session_cap.note: paused boxes cost nothing; no cap published

extras.price_note: Small shape, USD 0.0137 per hour, billed per second while running.

binding_note: The prepaid balance is the only limit: USD 25 at USD 0.0274 an hour is 912 hours, and nothing else in the published terms stops a box running.
confidence_note: Sizes, rates, the top-up requirement and the non-refundable term are on the pricing page read. Not established: whether the USD 25 is granted once per account or once per person, and whether a paused box is retained indefinitely.
